# New Europe Tours

> > New Europe Tours - European travel and tour services with integrated email communication infrastructure

New Europe Tours (neweuropetours.eu) is a European tour operator offering guided tours and travel experiences across Europe. The site utilizes Mandrill by Mailchimp for transactional email delivery to support customer communications.

## Key Topics

- European tours
- Travel services
- Guided tours
- Mandrill
- Mailchimp
- Transactional email
- Email service infrastructure
- The Rocket Science Group
- Customer communications
- Tour bookings

## Optional

- [Log in to Mandrill](https://mail.neweuropetours.eu/): Mandrill/Mailchimp transactional email service login portal for managing tour-related customer email communications
